title: RepoSettings
description: Per-repo settings stored at ~/.maiestro/repos/<owner>-<name>.json. This schema is the hand-written specification for the file format; the Rust RepoSettings struct must conform to it (a unit test enforces the two stay in sync). Unknown fields are tolerated so files written by a newer app version still load in an older one.

repo.description: Canonical "owner/name" string. Stored inside the file so repos_list can reconstruct the list without parsing the filename (which uses "-" and is ambiguous).

identity_id.description: Identity used for credentials and launching the agentic coding CLI for this repo.

cloned_repo_dir.description: Absolute path to the local cloned repo directory (the primary checkout mAIestro Code creates worktrees from).

worktree_prefix.description: Prefix for worktree locations. The full worktree path is `<worktree_prefix><workspace>/<repo>` (a string concatenation — the trailing segment is part of the directory name, not a path component). empty falls back to the default. Tilde-expanded at the use site.

env_files.description: Env files relative to cloned_repo_dir, copied into a freshly-created worktree at spawn.

post_spawn_commands.description: Shell commands to run in a freshly-created worktree, in order, right after it's created and before the editor opens (e.g. `pnpm install`). Run via your login shell so PATH and tool managers are available. Stops at the first command that fails. Empty by default.

delete_remote_on_teardown.description: Delete the branch on GitHub when its workspace is torn down. Never removes a branch with unmerged commits or an open PR.

comment_on_spawn.description: Comment on the issue when a workspace is spawned, recording its branch and directory. The issue is still assigned to you either way.

agent.description: The agentic coding CLI for this repo. Used for the session in each spawned worktree and for mAIestro Code's own drafting (issues, labels, PRs). null = use the global default. An existing worktree keeps the agentic coding CLI it was spawned with.

prompt_models.title: PromptModels
prompt_models.description: Which model runs mAIestro Code's own drafting prompts (issue, label, PR), per agentic coding CLI. Only the entry for the repo's agentic coding CLI is used.

claude.description: Any value `claude --model` accepts; empty uses the default (haiku).

codex.description: Any value `codex exec --model` accepts; empty uses the model configured in Codex itself.

antigravity.description: Any model id `agy models` lists (e.g. gemini-3.8-flash-low); empty uses the default (gemini-3.8-flash-low).

hidden.title: HideState
hidden.description: Repo-level hide/snooze state. null = visible. A hidden repo hides its work items too. Per-work-item state lives on the session record, not here.

snooze_until.description: Unix-epoch millis until which the item stays hidden. null = hidden indefinitely. Expiry is resolved on the frontend at render time; the backend stores the timestamp verbatim.

prompts.title: PromptOverrides
prompts.description: Per-repo overrides for the instructions sent to the repo's agentic coding CLI. Each field empty/null uses the built-in default. The runtime context (your idea, the issue, the diff) is appended automatically and is not part of these overrides.

draft_issue.default: Based on this idea for a change to this codebase, draft a GitHub issue. Reply with ONLY a JSON object of the form {"title": string, "body": string, "short_title": string}. The title is a concise summary (max ~70 characters). The body is clear markdown describing the work. The short_title is a short, human-readable session label — plain words with normal spaces and capitalization (NOT a slug or branch name, so no dashes/underscores), at most ~5 words / 40 characters, no issue number, no trailing punctuation; it should read well, not just be the title cut off.
draft_issue.description: Instruction for drafting a GitHub issue from your idea.

short_label.default: Summarize this GitHub issue as a short workspace label. Reply with ONLY the label, nothing else. The label is a short, human-readable session label — plain words with normal spaces and capitalization (NOT a slug or branch name, so no dashes/underscores), 2-4 words, at most 40 characters, no issue number, no trailing punctuation. Prefer concrete keywords from the issue (component names, actions) over a generic rephrasing.
short_label.description: Instruction for summarizing an issue into a short workspace label.

draft_pr.default: Draft a GitHub pull request description for the changes below. Reply with ONLY a JSON object of the form {"title": string, "body": string}. The title is a concise summary of the overall change (max ~70 characters). The body is clear markdown explaining what changed and why; do not include a heading that repeats the title.
draft_pr.description: Instruction for drafting a pull request description from the diff.
